about: SDK 3.0.1: turning sharing off, or deleting what was shared, while an upload is in flight (SPEC.md section 11.7; make_sharing_off.py). Each case is a situation a test builds with a stub server: a recording is being uploaded, the stub HOLDS the request named by `held` (it does not answer), the learner does `action`, and where `then` is `on` turns sharing on again as soon as the call returned. `assert` lists what must hold, each as `key: sentence`. Every case is run `runs` times; a report gives runs passed of `runs` per case.

rules.R1: after the off call returns, no byte of audio leaves the device, whatever was in flight
rules.R2: the off call returns within off_bound_ms even when a request hangs
rules.R3: nothing unsent remains on the device after off or after delete, also after the held request came back
rules.R4: turning sharing on again afterwards works in the same run

cases.name: put held, off
cases.held_what: a segment PUT to its upload URL
cases.action_what: the learner turns sharing off (the settings switch, setOn(false))
assert: returns_within_bound: the call returns within off_bound_ms and does not throw, although the held request never answers by itself
no_request_after: no start, URL, PUT or take-list request STARTS after the call was made

no_audio_after: zero bytes of audio are sent after the call returned: neither a PUT that starts after the call was made nor the rest of a PUT that was in flight (an SDK says how many bytes its transport may already have handed to the system)
nothing_unsent_on_device: when the call returns, no unsent recording, segment or state file of the queue is left on the device (on disk, not only in memory)
still_nothing_after_release: the held request is then let go (it answers 200): the queue is still empty and still nothing was sent

cases.name: put held, delete
cases.held_what: a segment PUT to its upload URL
cases.action_what: the learner deletes what they shared (delete), and the server accepts the deletion
assert: returns_within_bound: the call returns within off_bound_ms and does not throw, although the held request never answers by itself
no_request_after: no start, URL, PUT or take-list request STARTS after the call was made

no_audio_after: zero bytes of audio are sent after the call returned: neither a PUT that starts after the call was made nor the rest of a PUT that was in flight (an SDK says how many bytes its transport may already have handed to the system)
nothing_unsent_on_device: when the call returns, no unsent recording, segment or state file of the queue is left on the device (on disk, not only in memory)
still_nothing_after_release: the held request is then let go (it answers 200): the queue is still empty and still nothing was sent
queue_stopped_before_the_server_is_asked: no upload request starts between the delete call and the server's answer to it
sharing_is_off_after_an_accepted_delete: sharing is off when the call returns, and the learner is not asked again (asking has ended)
on_again_works: the learner turns sharing on with the switch; a recording made after that is uploaded in the same run, under a new contributor

cases.name: put held, delete refused
cases.held_what: a segment PUT to its upload URL
cases.action_what: the learner deletes what they shared, and the server does not take it (an error, or no answer)
assert: returns_within_bound: the call returns within off_bound_ms of the server's answer and reports the failure
queue_stopped_before_the_server_is_asked: no upload request starts between the delete call and the server's answer to it
a_refused_delete_changes_nothing: sharing is still on, and nothing was deleted on the device
queue_resumes: the recording that was in flight is uploaded in the same run once the held request is let go
